text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-saaann!! What do you want in your 
sandwich?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-chan, I think you might be leaving 
out some really important details...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Rice and the others wanted to give 
you sandwiches as a birthday present...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Carrot? Cucumber? Strawberry? Apple? Hey, 
hey! Which one do you want?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Anything Urara likes is okay!? Then Urara 
carrots!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just combine them! Carrot and 
strawberry sandwiches!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eh, but if you combine yummy things with 
yummy things, won't it taste even yummier?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A-Alright... I get it, I get it already...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it together, a fruit 
sandwich... I'll tell you what I want... 
as we go.
